name: Corrected structural intervention with exact shared-core VJPs and no-cut option
parent: MA-1174 retrospective audit, different fresh worlds
research_question: Can selecting structural interventions based on exact edge-to-shared-core gradients and prospectively held-out dev recovery outperform never cutting and simpler pruning at fixed real-update count and after accounting for extra search computation?
scope: Controlled 8D synthetic function regression, NOT a trained natural language model and NOT joint node/loop/view count optimization

architecture.mirror_operator: fixed Householder -> tanh -> inverse Householder after learned signed permutation page mixing
architecture.hard_masks: pruned edges no longer decoded or executed; inactive slots retained in training tensor but serialized only if active

data.split_generation: Existing deterministic dataset generator, seed-disjoint from MA-1174; student never observes teacher parameters or active indices
data.denominator: train-only mean squared teacher target; no fresh access before checksum-complete checkpoints

training.torch: CPU eager float32; threads=1; no CUDA, clock unlocked
training.unselected_probes: discard all candidate cloned optimizer/model state; apply only selected binary mask to real trajectory
training.probe_batching: all forks and keep use identical predetermined future batches; RNG independent of fresh
training.selection: evaluate noncut and all available candidate four-edge masks on DEV after exactly H updates, choose best if gain >=0.0005; otherwise keep
training.gradient_conflict: exact per-edge VJP through physical shared core; score -cos(g_i, g_total-g_i) where cosine negative, weighted by |g_i|; average exact g_i across 2 training mini-batches
training.gradient_ablation: use smallest exact |g_i| among active edges
training.search_accounting: log real updates, all cloned probe updates, core VJP overhead and active-edge MAC proxy separately
training.same_final_mask_control: train from original seed with final long-guard selected mask for 420 updates
training.extra_budget_control: mirror keep for 820 real updates (420+400), not exactly total CPU FLOPs; compare actual measured compute separately
training.posthoc_horizon_audit: H=120 DEV-only fork audit at the first cut event from the same exact checkpoint; never used in candidate choice or fresh selection

decision.mechanism_pass: exact sum of per-edge VJP matches full core gradient relative <= 1e-4; cut alters future gradient on same train batch; hard cut removes computation
decision.guard_validity_pass: in all 20 (2x5x2) long-guard decisions, cut iff best dev probe improves no-cut by at least 0.0005; never force an inferior cut
decision.learning_pass: long guarded Mirror fresh-NMSE >=5% lower than BOTH short guarded and no-cut 420-update baselines in at least 7/10 paired world-seed runs, AND median OOD NMSE not worse than either
decision.mirror_specific_pass: Mirror long guard fresh-NMSE >=5% lower than non-Mirror direct-tanh guarded long in >=7/10 pairs; same optimizer and trainable scalar count
decision.adoption: learning + mirror_specific passes and no worse quality-per-actual-byte and train-compute than strongest control; large probe cost can render quality gains non-economic
decision.no_unqualified_claim: Improvement on aligned synthetic Mirror teacher alone is mechanism evidence; even all 10 passes would not establish language generality or universal MLP representation

uncertainty: paired 5 seeds per two synthetic teacher worlds: descriptive, not population CI; report all pairs, failures, CPU/machine and checkpoint hashes
research_integrity: fresh/OOD sealed until every model trained and manifest hashed; no threshold or settings changes after seeing fresh; prior MA-1174 FAIL preserved, no main merge
